note: Deterministic arithmetic with one correct answer. Unlike the counting set, failures here ARE a signal: a quant or runtime that breaks arithmetic while prose still reads fine is the dangerous failure mode, because the output looks confident.

cases.q: What is 144 divided by 12? Number only.
What is 2 to the power of 10? Number only.
A train travels 60 miles in 45 minutes. How many miles per hour? Number only.
If x + 7 = 22, what is x? Number only.
What is the sum of the first 10 positive integers? Number only.
